Executive Order 11039
EXTENSION OF THE PRESIDENT’S COMMISSION ON CAMPAIGN COSTS
B y virtue of the authority vested in me as P resident of the U nited 
States, it is ordered th a t Executive O rder No. 10974 of November 8, 
1961, be, and it is hereby, amended, effective as of Ju ly  1, 1962, as 
follow s:

(1) B y inserting before the period at the end of the first sentence 
of Section 5 a comma and the following : “and from  any thereto cor­
responding appropriation available for the fiscal year 1963”.

(2) B y substituting for the last sentence of the order the following : 
“The Commission shall term inate as of November 1,1962.”
